Name: PerPlayerFarm
Author: DerexSV
Description:
[b]Per Player Farm[/b] creates a separate farm space for each farmhand in multiplayer.

Instead of everyone sharing only the main Farm map, each invited player can have a personal [b]PPF_* farm[/b], with proper entrance redirection and owner-based mailbox behavior. This helps organize multiplayer progression while keeping each player’s space clearer and easier to manage.

[b]Built for:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15+[/b]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.1.7+[/b]
[/list]
Important multiplayer note
For consistent behavior, host and farmhands should use the same mod version and the same config values.

[b]What this mod does[/b]
[list]
[*]Creates and manages per-player farm locations ([b]PPF_*[/b]) in multiplayer.
[*]Redirects farm entrances so farmhands go to their assigned PPF farm when appropriate.
[*]Keeps mailbox behavior owner-aware in PPF farms.
[*]Provides in-game chat commands for cleanup and safe uninstall.
[*]Includes translation support.
[/list]

[b]Config (config.json)[/b]
[list]
[*][b]WarpToPPFOnHouseExit[/b] (default: [b]true[/b])
When enabled, farmhands are redirected to their own PPF farm after leaving their cabin.[*][b]RedirectFarmhandsToPPF[/b] (default: [b]true[/b])
When enabled, farm entrances are redirected so farmhands go to their assigned PPF farm.[*][b]OpenTravelMenuKey[/b] (default: [b]K[/b])
Key used to open the travel menu.[*][b]DefaultPPFMapType[/b] (default: [b]null[/b])
Optional map override for newly created PPF farms. Leave empty/null for normal behavior. Examples: Maps/Farm, Maps/Farm_Fishing, Maps/Farm_Foraging, Maps/Farm_Mining, Maps/Farm_Combat, Maps/Farm_FourCorners, Maps/Farm_Island, Maps/Farm_Ranching[/list]

[b]Travel menu key behavior[/b]
[list]
[*]Default key is [b]K[/b] (changeable in config/GMCM).
[*]The travel menu only opens while you are in the main [b]Farm[/b] or in a [b]PPF_*[/b] farm.
[/list]

[b]In-game chat commands[/b]
To use commands, open the in-game chat by pressing [b]T[/b], then type:

[list]
[*][b]/ppfclearfarm[/b]
Clears placed objects and selected terrain features in the current PPF farm.Guest players: can only use this in [b]their own[/b] assigned PPF farm.Host player: can use it in any PPF farm.[*][b]/ppfclearfarm all[/b]
Host only. Clears all loaded PPF farms.[*][b]/ppfuninstall[/b]
Host only. Starts uninstall confirmation flow (2-step).[*][b]/ppfuninstall confirm[/b]
Host only. Confirms uninstall and removes PPF data created by the mod.[/list]

[b]Important before uninstall[/b]
Before confirming uninstall, move anything important from PPF farms back to the main Farm.

After uninstall:
[list]
[*]Save the game
[*]Close the game
[*]Remove the mod from your Mods folder
[/list]
[b]Tip for moving buildings and animals[/b]
If you want to move buildings or farm animals between farms, use:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20606]Relocate Buildings And Farm Animals[/url]

[b]Translations[/b]
This mod supports i18n and currently includes:
[list]
[*][b]English[/b] ([i]default.json[/i])
[*][b]Portuguese (Brazil)[/b] ([i]pt.json[/i])
[/list]
If you want to add your language, you can create a translation file for it.

[b]FAQ (Quick Answers)[/b]

[b]Q: Is this mod single-player or multiplayer?[/b]
A: It is designed for [b]multiplayer[/b]. The main feature is per-player PPF farms for farmhands.

[b]Q: Which versions are supported?[/b]
A: Built for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.1.7+[/b].

[b]Q: Do all players need to install the mod?[/b]
A: For consistent multiplayer behavior, [b]host and farmhands should all use the mod[/b].

[b]Q: Do host and guests need the same mod config settings?[/b]
A: [b]Yes.[/b] Keep the mod config values the same for host and farmhands. Different settings can cause inconsistent entrances/warps and unexpected behavior between players.

[b]Q: How do I use commands?[/b]
A: Press [b]T[/b] in-game to open chat, then type commands like [b]/ppfclearfarm[/b] or [b]/ppfuninstall[/b].

[b]Q: Why can’t a guest clear another player’s PPF farm?[/b]
A: By design, guests can only clear [b]their own[/b] assigned PPF farm. The host can manage all PPF farms.

[b]Q: What does /ppfuninstall do?[/b]
A: It removes PPF data created by the mod (host only, with confirmation). Before confirming, move important items/animals back to the main Farm.

[b]Q: Can this mod move buildings or animals between farms?[/b]
A: Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20606]Relocate Buildings And Farm Animals[/url] for that.
